import html # Predefined template for a blog post (simple example) BLOG_FORMAT = """

{heading}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a user‑submitted blog entry for safe display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title of the blog post. content : str The main text body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted blog post ready for rendering in HTML. """ # Escape user input to prevent XSS (CWE‑79) safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Format using the predefined template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(heading=safe_heading, body=safe_content) return formatted_post
